key: Shown as the server title in the Sources list. If empty, the host or the link fragment is used.
value: 在源列表中显示为服务器标题。如果为空，则使用主机或链接片段。

key: Paste anything: share-URI (one per line), a sing-box outbound or config JSON, or [Interface]/[Peer] WireGuard conf.
value: 粘贴任何内容：共享 URI（每行一个）、单个出站或配置 JSON，或 [Interface]/[Peer] WireGuard conf。

key: Preview of what this source unpacks into. Edit it and your version wins — the fields above stop overwriting it.
value: 预览此源代码解压后的内容。编辑它，您的版本获胜 - 上面的字段将停止覆盖它。

key: Edited by hand — the fields no longer overwrite this JSON.
value: 手动编辑 — 字段不再覆盖此 JSON。

key: One-off keys are consumed at first login; the node identity then lives in the state directory. Deleting the profile registers a new device — use a reusable key for that.
value: 一次性密钥在第一次登录时消耗；然后，节点身份位于状态目录中。删除配置文件会注册一个新设备 - 为此使用可重复使用的密钥。

key: optional — the official coordination server by default
value: 可选 — 默认为官方协调服务器

key: optional — this machine's name by default
value: 可选 — 默认情况下该机器的名称

key: Ephemeral node (removed from the tailnet when it goes offline)
value: 临时节点（离线时从尾网移除）

key: Accept routes advertised by other nodes
value: 接受其他节点通告的路由

key: macOS is blocking the launcher's access to the local network: the system rejects the connection instantly, before it even leaves this Mac. Enable the launcher in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network. If it is already enabled there, the app bundle's code signature is broken (typical after swapping a dev binary into the installed app) — reinstall the launcher.
value: macOS 阻止启动器访问本地网络：系统甚至在离开这台 Mac 之前就立即拒绝连接。在系统设置 → 隐私和安全 → 本地网络中启用启动器。如果它已在那里启用，则应用程序包的代码签名已损坏（通常在将开发二进制文件交换到已安装的应用程序后） - 重新安装启动器。

key: The machine is answering again — the failure was transient (macOS re-checked its local-network policy or the network blinked). Press Connect again.
value: 机器再次应答 - 故障是暂时的（macOS 重新检查其本地网络策略或网络闪烁）。再次按连接。
指向已删除节点的链接

key: Node %q was deleted. Links through it were removed, and anything that chose it as a target needs a new one. Affected: %s
value: 节点 %q 已删除。通过它的链接已被删除，任何选择它作为目标的东西都需要一个新的链接。受影响：%s

key: tag %q is already taken — directions, nodes and service outbounds share one namespace
value: 标签 %q 已被占用 — 方向、节点和服务出站共享一个命名空间

key: node %q cannot be added to a Direction directly — use a filter
value: 节点 %q 无法直接添加到方向 — 使用过滤器

key: Pick the machine whose settings you want to copy here.
value: 在此处选择您要复制其设置的机器。

key: There are no other machines to clone from. Add a machine on the Remote tab, or configure the local one first.
value: 没有其他机器可供克隆。在“远程”选项卡上添加计算机，或先配置本地计算机。

key: %s has no saved configuration yet — there is nothing to clone from it.
value: %s 尚未保存配置 — 没有任何内容可从中克隆。

key: This replaces the current settings of this machine. The current state is saved as a snapshot first — you can get it back with Read.
value: 这将替换本机的当前设置。当前状态首先保存为快照 - 您可以通过“读取”将其恢复。

key: Could not save a snapshot of the current settings, so nothing was changed
value: 无法保存当前设置的快照，因此未进行任何更改

key: Settings copied from %s. Press Save to apply them to this machine; the previous state is saved as %s.
value: 从 %s 复制的设置。按“保存”将它们应用到本机；先前的状态保存为 %s。

key: Traffic follows the system default route.
value: 流量遵循系统默认路由。

key: Cannot verify: the machine's interfaces are unavailable.
value: 无法验证：机器的接口不可用。

key: Add an interface from the machine's list.
value: 从机器列表中添加接口。

key: No interfaces to add — type the name manually.
value: 无需添加接口 — 手动输入名称。

key: no IP address — no traffic will go through it
value: 没有 IP 地址 — 没有流量通过它

key: this is a tunnel — the core cannot use it as an uplink
value: 这是一条隧道 - 核心不能将其用作上行链路

key: Tunnel — traffic will go out through it.
value: 隧道——交通将通过它出去。

key: tunnel: traffic will go out through it
value: 隧道：交通将通过它出去

key: loopback — no traffic will leave the machine through it
value: 环回——没有流量会通过它离开机器

key: Traffic will go through this interface.
Auto-detect is on — the core picks the interface itself.
value: 自动检测已开启 - 核心自行选择接口。
空 — 遵循系统默认路线

key: The machine answers. Click to see the exchange log.
value: 机器回答。点击查看交换日志。

key: No answer to the last poll — retrying. Click to see the exchange log.
value: 上次民意调查没有答案 - 重试。点击查看交换日志。

key: The machine is not answering. Click to see the exchange log.
value: 机器没有应答。点击查看交换日志。

key: Not connected. Click to see the exchange log.
value: 未连接。点击查看交换日志。

key: No exchange with this machine yet — press Connect.
value: 尚未与该机器进行交换 — 按“连接”。

key: No answer to the last %d poll(s) — retrying.
value: 最后 %d 次民意调查没有答复 — 正在重试。

key: Used when a subscription has neither its own schedule nor a profile-update-interval header. Go-duration form: 4h, 30m. Empty — built-in default (%s).
value: 当订阅既没有自己的计划也没有配置文件更新间隔标头时使用。持续时间形式：4h，30m。空 — 内置默认值 (%s)。

key: Used when a subscription has no max_nodes of its own — providers do not send this one in headers. It is a real parse limit, not a badge: nodes past it are not read at all. Empty — the hard ceiling (%d).
value: 当订阅没有自己的 max_nodes 时使用 - 提供者不会在标头中发送此节点。这是一个真正的解析限制，而不是一个徽章：超过它的节点根本不会被读取。空——硬天花板（%d）。

key: Update interval %q is not a duration — use forms like 4h or 30m.
value: 更新间隔 %q 不是持续时间 — 使用 4h 或 30m 等形式。

key: Max nodes %q is not a positive number.
value: 最大节点 %q 不是正数。

key: Tag prefix/postfix changed — every node of this source is renamed in the config.
value: 标签前缀/后缀已更改 - 该源的每个节点在配置中都被重命名。

key: A manual pick in a selector is remembered by the running core (cache.db) by tag, and the launcher cannot rewrite it: the affected selectors fall back to their default until you pick again. On a remote machine this applies to its own core.
value: 运行的核心 (cache.db) 通过标记记住选择器中的手动选择，并且启动器无法重写它：受影响的选择器会回退到默认值，直到您再次选择。在远程计算机上，这适用于其自己的核心。

key: Folder %q holds %d node(s). Delete them together with the folder, or move them to the root of the sources list?
value: 文件夹 %q 包含 %d 个节点。将它们与文件夹一起删除，还是将它们移动到源列表的根目录？

key: Fold this folder into a group
value: 将此文件夹折叠成一组

key: This folder has no nodes yet.
Read-only: the sing-box outbounds this folder is built from. Edit a node through its own entry on the Preview tab.
value: 只读：构建此文件夹的单一框。通过“预览”选项卡上节点自己的条目来编辑节点。

key: Create a folder first: Sources → ⋮ → Add folder.
value: 首先创建一个文件夹：Sources → ⋮ → 添加文件夹。

key: Tag %q is already taken in this container.
value: 标签 %q 已被占用在此容器中。
从此文件夹中删除节点 %q 吗？
节点与其订阅取消链接

key: Node %q was edited, so it no longer follows the subscription: the next fill will neither overwrite nor remove it.
value: 节点 %q 已被编辑，因此它不再遵循订阅：下一次填充既不会覆盖也不会删除它。

key: Folder is empty — paste links above to add nodes.
value: 文件夹为空 - 粘贴上面的链接以添加节点。
